The pure-function test test_scoped_selection_ids_af1b.py covers only 'only'-shaped scenarios and the E2E oracle drives only 'only' and 'filter' routes.
merged_from: The diff's docstring claims scoped_selection_ids also corrects a latent --except case (an excepted ticket's jira-key-targeted update must land in the excluded set), but no added test exercises the --except selection kind end-to-end; the pre-existing test_ticket_plan_shadow.py::test_selection_except_inverts_scope_semantics uses local-id targets that match the selection ids directly and never drives the new bound-key expansion. The helper's kind-agnostic expansion is covered by test_selected_bound_id_gains_its_jira_key_target, so this is advisory coverage completeness, not a functional gap.
